events.verdict: Walker IV's (SAS) arm comes down and makes contact with the ball during Harden's (BKN) driving shot attempt.
Jordan (BKN) gathers the pass and legally takes two steps prior to releasing the pass.
Jordan (BKN) legally establishes position in bounds prior to receiving the pass.
Murray (SAS) legally contests Irving's (BKN) jump shot attempt.
Irving (BKN) and Mills (SAS) engage in incidental foot to foot contact after Mills makes the pass.
Jordan (BKN) jumps vertically and absorbs the body contact with DeRozan (SAS) and marginal contact occurs with DeRozan's arm when Jordan brings his arms downward.
Jordan (BKN) establishes himself in a legal position in Mills' (SAS) path and he absorbs the oncoming contact during the pick.
Poeltl (SAS) makes incidental contact to Harden's (BKN) arm after he releases the ball during his driving shot attempt.
Murray (SAS) places two hands on Irving (BKN) during the drive and the contact affects his SQBR.
Murray (SAS) reaches in and avoids making contact to Irving's (BKN) arm.
Mills (SAS) moves laterally into Irving's (BKN) path during the drive but the body contact that occurs is marginal.
Harden (BKN) stops and turns into Murray (SAS), delivering contact that affects his SQBR.
Harden (BKN) briefly places a hand on Murray's (SAS) body during his shooting motion and quickly removes it.
DeRozan (SAS) commits a take foul on Irving (BKN).

events.category: Turnover: Lost Ball Out of Bounds
events.verdict: DeRozan (SAS) loses control of the ball during his drive and he is the last to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds.

Marginal contact occurs with Bates-Diop's (SAS) head as Harris (BKN) establishes himself in a vertical position.   Contact to an opponent?s head/face can be deemed marginal when the result of a natural basketball move, provided the contact is not disproportionate or uncontrolled.
